description: This file declares the interface for the Uplink Shared Channel (UL-SCH) demultiplexer in a 3GPP LTE/NR implementation, including configuration parameters, class definitions, and method signatures.

classes.name: ulsch_demultiplex
classes.description: Interface class for UL-SCH demultiplexer, providing methods to configure CSI Part 2 and perform demultiplexing of UL-SCH signals.

methods.name: set_csi_part2
methods.description: Configures the CSI Part 2 decoder buffer with the number of bits and encoded bits.

methods.name: demultiplex
methods.description: Performs the demultiplexing of UL-SCH data into separate soft bit buffers for data, HARQ-ACK, and CSI Part 1.
